rationale.conceptual: Established non-trivial method (DFT+U for defect supercells). Requires understanding of supercell construction, Hubbard U corrections, and spin-polarized calculations. Not novel but needs careful implementation to get correct magnetic moments.
rationale.execution: Multi-stage pipeline: building five defect models, geometry relaxation with DFT (possibly many ionic steps), and SCF calculations. Involves external DFT tooling (Quantum ESPRESSO) and scripting for job management. Not a single script, but manageable.
